subject: Error on installing shinyapps from Github using devtools

messages.author: 1de1f9aed0e330b1
messages.subject: Error on installing shinyapps from Github using devtools
parts:
I am trying to install shinyapps, and get the following error message.  Is it something to do with having spaces in my path name for the temporary directory. If so, how do I solve this please?

I am new to shiny and have limited R experience.

Thanks.



devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps') Downloading github repo rstudio/shinyapps@master Installing shinyapps "C:/Program Files/R/R-3.1.3/bin/x64/R" --vanilla CMD INSTALL "C:/Users/David \ Hindley/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpMZWnVd/devtools72a82204642b/rstudio-shinyapps-75c7269" --library="C:/Users/David \ Hindley/Documents/R/win-library/3.1" --install-tests 'C:\Program' is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file. Error: Command failed (1)

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error on installing shinyapps from Github using devtools
parts:
Hi,

I don't think this issue is specifically related to the shinyapps package. The only solution I'm aware of is to uninstall R and reinstall it to C:\R-XXX\ not C:\Program Files\R-XXX.

Checkout this bug for a similar issue:

https://github.com/ramnathv/slidify/issues/247

-Andy

that he is aware of this potential issue.

There is one thing under your control, though, which is you can
install R to a directory that does not contain spaces as Andy
suggested.

Regards,

parts:
Right. It is tricky to get system commands working on Windows --
sometimes you have to use system2(), sometimes shell(), and sometimes
you even have to add extra quotes around the command that has been
processed by shQuote(). I have no idea what went wrong here then.

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
